name: ADDRESS_SUBTYPE
description: A code that uniquely identifies the ADDRESS SUBTYPE.  Examples: - Street address - Electronic address - Geospatial locator - Parcel address - Post office box address - Military address

name: COUNTRY
description: A geopolitical region with sovereign governing.  Examples: - USA - Canada - Denmark

name: COUNTRY_CODE_STANDARD
description: This entity is a link between the generic country identifier and the various international standards for country codes such as ISO.

name: COUNTRY_CODE_STANDARD_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of coding standard for countries. name: COUNTRY_GROUP
description: A grouping of countries.  Examples: - Europe - Asia - Middle East

name: COUNTRY_TO_COUNTRY_GROUP
description: This entity allows for a country to be in many country groups. For example, groupings could be European Union, Nordics and Baltics. Sweden and Estonia can below to two of these groups.

name: ELECTRONIC_ADDRESS
description: A nonphysical/virtual ADDRESS. Could be an email, FTP, or URL.  Examples: - clark@kryptonite.com - FTP.att.net/bob

name: ELECTRONIC_ADDRESS_SUBTYPE
description: Specifies the type of ELECTRONIC ADDRESS such as email, FTP, URL, or internet protocol address.

name: INTERNET_PROTOCOL_ADDRESS
description: Internet Protocol (IP) addresses are assigned to every computer or device on a TCP/IP network such as the Internet. description: Maps ranges of Internet Protocol Addresses to their geographical origin. name: ISO_3166_ALPHA-2_COUNTRY
description: This is the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code that is a two-letter country code and which is the most widely used of the three country code sets, and which is used most prominently for the Internet's country code top level domains (with a few exceptions). name: ISO_3166_ALPHA-3_COUNTRY
description: This is the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code that is the three-letter country code set, which allows a better visual association between the codes and the country names than the alpha-2 codes.  The description can be found when you link with the ISO 3166 NUMERIC COUNTRY entity.

name: ISO_3166_COUNTRY_STANDARD
description: This is a type of country code standard that is the ISO 3166 three-digit numeric standard for country code. It links to the independent entity for country codes, which also contains the alpha-2 and alpha-3 ISO standard codes.

name: ISO_3166_COUNTRY_SUBDIVISION
description: This is the ISO 3166-2 standard code set that defines codes for identifying the principal subdivisions (e.g., states or provinces) of all countries that have ISO 3166-1 codes. description: This entity contains the code values for the territory according to the ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision coding scheme. name: ISO_3166_COUNTRY_SUBDIVISION_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of subdivision such as province, state, prefecture.

name: ISO_3166_NUMERIC_COUNTRY
description: ISO 3166-1 is part of the ISO 3166 standard published by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), and defines codes for the names of countries, dependent territories, and special areas of geographical interest. name: ISO_4217_COUNTRY_CURRENCY
description: A currency can be used by many countries (e.g., Euro) and a country can have many currencies (e.g., Switzerland). This entity provides for that.

name: ISO_4217_COUNTRY_CURRENCY_ROLE
description: This is the role that a currency might have with a country such as in Switzerland it might be the official country standard of Swiss Franc or the WIR Franc with the role of private currency.

name: OVERSEAS_MILITARY_ADDRESS
description: The concept of getting mail to and from military personnel stationed overseas dates back many years. name: PARCEL_ADDRESS
description: The legal representation of an address as recorded in the county/parish records.

name: REGION
description: This entity represents an intermediate geographical grouping level within the geographic hierarchy that groups TERRITORYs into a REGION.  Examples: - Northwest region - Southwest region - Tri-state region

name: ROUTING_TRANSIT_NUMBER_ADDRESS
description: A routing transit number (RTN) or ABA number is a nine-digit code, used in the United States, which, for instance, appears on the bottom of negotiable instruments such as a check that identifies which financial institution it is drawn upon. name: STREET_ADDRESS
description: A STREET ADDRESS that represents a physical mailing address.

name: STREET_ADDRESS_DETAIL
description: The separate components of a physical address, for example, street direction and street number.

name: STREET_ADDRESS_JAPAN
description: The street address in Japan is a combination of the district, the block, and a building number.

name: STREET_ADDRESS_LINE
description: This entity contains additional text lines for a street address.  How these lines are used can vary by country.

name: STREET_SUFFIX_TYPE
description: This minor entity defines the type of street such as street, lane, or road as used for addresses.  Examples: - AVE = avenue - RD = road - LN = lane

name: TERRITORY
description: A geographic region within a COUNTRY. Can be a state, province, Bundesland, capital area or overseas military area. name: TERRITORY_STANDARD
description: This entity associates a territory with standard codes for territories or country subdivisions. Examples of standard coding schemes include the ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision standard and the United States Postal Service standard.

name: TERRITORY_STANDARD_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of territory standard such as ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision standard or the United States Postal System coding standard.

name: TERRITORY_TYPE
description: This is a classification of territory.  A territory could be a political area such as a state or province. name: WMO_COUNTRY_STANDARD
description: This is the country code standard created, owned, and maintained by the World Meteorological Organization (WMO), which is frequently seen and used in weather-related data sources. It is currently defined as a two-character alpha code.
